comments.author: RvZ
comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Icon of Saint Christopher

Quest name: Everchanging Saint (Chrono Quest - 2nd period,18th Century)
Quest location: Seville Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r10 Search,r12 Art,ARC(Far North Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Handprint of Peter the Great discovery (from "A thorough investigation of a czar" quest)

comments.author: Angelica
comments.body:
Also available from London Adventurer's Guild

1. Speak to Merchant in Venice's Tavern
2. Speak to Port Official in St Petersburg 2x
3. Speak to Scholar in St Petersburg 4x
4. Use Observe and Search in St Petersburg Cathedral. Directly right from the door when you walk in. In the right corner.
